Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1414
Claimant:
Andrea Ashley
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
December 6, 2023
Received first notice of loss for a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured reports being stopped
when the other vehicle struck the rear bumper, and the claimant is listed as the passenger in the struck vehicle.
Confirmed the insured driver is named on the policy and coverage was in force at the time of loss.
December 26, 2023
Police report obtained. The reporting officer and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was seated in the
vehicle and that the ipmact occurred as described. Scene photos and the other driver's statement match the account
given at first notice.
February 14, 2024
Inspected the damaged vehicle. The rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamp assembly show damage consistent with the
reported impact angle and speed. No prior daamge to the vehicle is known from the file or from the insured's history
with us.
February 27, 2024
Claimant is represented by counsel, and all contact is now routed through the attorney's office. Counsel submitted a
demand package including medical records for neck and upper back complaints. The claimant has since added a few
minor details to the account, but the core description of the crash has stayed consistent across statements.
May 10, 2024
Reviewed the medical records. The claimant was treated for the same neck and upper back area within the past two
years, and that prior condition appears to add to the current complaints. At this stage it is not yet clear how much of
the present injury, if any, came from this collision.
May 30, 2024
Treatemnt followed a typical course of care, with physical therapy and follow-up visits tapering off as the claimant's
symptoms improved. Nothing in the records suggests the treatment pattern departs from what would be expected for
this type of injury. Requested an independent medical review to help separate the prior condition from the current
complaints.
May 31, 2024
Coverage confirmed in force at the time of loss, and nothing in the file suggests the dmaage predates the policy start.
Reserves reviewed and held pending the independent medical review and counsel's response to our request for
additional records.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
